article.headline: Memphis faces Portland, looks for 4th straight road win
article.description: Memphis Grizzlies (4-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, fourth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Memphis faces Portland, looks for 4th straight road win
article.linkText: Memphis faces Portland, looks for 4th straight road win
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (4-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, fourth in the Western Conference) Portland, Oregon; Thursday, 10 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Memphis will try to keep its three-game road win streak alive when the Grizzlies take on Portland. Portland finished 42-40 overall, 29-23 in Western Conference action and 24-17 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Trail Blazers allowed opponents to score 115.8 points per game and shoot 47.1% from the field last season. Memphis finished 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Grizzlies allowed opponents to score 120.7 points per game and shoot 48.5% from the field last season. INJURIES: Trail Blazers: Shaedon Sharpe: out (meniscus). Grizzlies: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
